trajectory.patch:
The compilation error is due to missing semicolons after `ARG_UNUSED` macro calls in `tests/subsys/pm/power_states_api/src/test_driver.c`. The `ARG_UNUSED(x)` macro expands to `(void)(x)`, which is an expression. To be used as a statement, it must be terminated with a semicolon.

Without semicolons, the code `ARG_UNUSED(dev) ARG_UNUSED(action)` expands to `(void)(dev) (void)(action)`. The C compiler interprets this as an attempt to call `(void)(dev)` as a function with `(void)(action)` as its argument, which is invalid and leads to the reported compilation errors.

The fix is to add semicolons after each `ARG_UNUSED` call to make them valid C statements.

tests/subsys/pm/power_states_api/src/test_driver.c
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
	ARG_UNUSED(dev)
	ARG_UNUSED(action);
========
	ARG_UNUSED(dev);
	ARG_UNUSED(action);
>>>>>>>> REPLACE
